function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT vendor_id, sku, period, unit_price_orig, contract_unit_price, qty, fx_rate,
       (unit_price_orig - contract_unit_price) * qty * fx_rate AS excess_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
WHERE period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
  AND unit_price_orig > contract_unit_price
ORDER BY period, vendor_id, sku","purpose":"First query per playbook: list purchase lines where unit_price_orig > contract_unit_price for Aug/Sep 2026, compute excess CAD."}
